mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthened economic demand, boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a strong labor market drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances meeting the joint labor market trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% month-over-month increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain acceleration, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) following the INDPRO growth trigger.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $350B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window following the RSAFS growth trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) maintains accommodative monetary conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 8% and PAYEMS growth slows (< 100k new jobs), a weakening labor market drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 35% of instances meeting the joint labor market trigger.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 600k units signals a strong housing market, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) following the HOUST trigger in non-recessionary periods.
